## Accepted partial results, attempt 1/5

Problem 10600027 / AMR-105-0027, rank 1253. Full ordinary-pass classification of oriented closed virtual knots remains unresolved. No novelty or exhaustive continuing-openness certification is claimed.

The complete report proves that Kauffman's odd writhe modulo four is invariant under the actual ordinary oriented four-crossing pass, with one-pass change in {−4,0,4}. It preserves the complete flat-trivial two-arrow witness and explicit RII bigon, insertion proving at least two pass classes in every oriented flat fiber, the sharp distance bound and complete six-arrow one-pass example. The pass does not replace classical crossings with virtual crossings.

The separate supplement proves A/R ≅ B ⊕ Z/2 for the universal additive n-writhe data, including arbitrary-integer-potential geometric realization with a protected ordinary-pass disk and explicit normalization of the second orientation. The result concerns the subgroup generated across all actual one-pass pairs; it gives no fixed-knot reachability claim and no sufficiency of flat type plus the binary coordinate.

Both complete proofs and the authored independent mathematical assessment are retained. Kauffman's odd writhe and flat obstruction, Chrisman's long-knot work, and Satoh–Taniguchi's n-writhes and flat antisymmetric data are credited. Virtualized-pass unknotting results are not imported. The trefoil/unknot question through virtual intermediates and the broader concordance/cobordism target remain open within this work.

The seven-file edition is AI-assisted and unrefereed. Scoped acceptance is not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. Public source metadata records historical retrieval, actual inspection and source limits without claiming new edition-stage scholarly inspection. Programs, diagnostics, computed results, datasets, copied source bodies, images and private coordination/version identities are excluded wholesale; no excluded computation is rewritten as prose.

QUEUE.md and unrelated entries are unchanged. Editorial preparation adds no substantive proof turn and does not reset partial attempt 1/5. No merge, release, DOI or outside outreach is requested.

Base commit: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`.
